config.battlecorrection.title: Battle Correction Config
config.battlecorrection.pvp.tooltip:
Controls the damage dealt between players in PVP combat.
§70.5§r = 50% damage
§71.0§r = Normal damage (default)
§72.0§r = 200% damage
§70.0§r = Disable PVP completely
config.battlecorrection.pvpHurtItself.to:
Controls damage when a player hurts themselves.
Includes: your own arrows, TNT you ignited, your own splash potions, etc.
§70.0§r = Prevent all self-damage
§71.0§r = Normal (default)
When enabled, uncharged attacks deal reduced damage.
Discourages spam-clicking and rewards timing.
§7true§r = Uncharged attacks deal less damage
§7false§r = No extra correction, vanilla charge mechanics apply (default)
config.battlecorrection.attackCooldown.t:
Toggle the 1.9+ attack cooldown system.
§7true§r = 1.9+ combat with cooldown (default)
§7false§r = 1.8 combat with no cooldown
config.battlecorrection.hurtTimeEntity.t:
Adjusts invulnerability frames after an entity takes damage.
Formula: §eNew Time = Vanilla 10 ticks × (1 + Value)§r
§7-0.5§r = Half duration (faster attacks)
§70.0§r = Normal (default)
§71.0§r = Double duration (slower attacks)
config.battlecorrection.hurtTimePlayer.t:
Adjusts invulnerability frames after a player takes damage.
Formula: §eNew Time = Vanilla 10 ticks × (1 + Value)§r
§7-0.5§r = Half duration (more vulnerable)
§70.0§r = Normal (default)
§71.0§r = Double duration (more tanky)
config.battlecorrection.playerMeleeAttac:
Multiplier for all melee damage dealt by players.
Affects: swords, axes, fists, and other direct attacks.
§70.5§r = 50% damage
§71.0§r = Normal (default)
§72.0§r = 200% damage
config.battlecorrection.playerArrowAttac:
Multiplier for arrow damage dealt by players.
Affects: bows, crossbows, tridents, and all arrow projectiles.
§70.5§r = 50% damage
§71.0§r = Normal (default)
§72.0§r = 200% damage
config.battlecorrection.playerProjectile:
Multiplier for non-arrow projectile damage.
Affects: snowballs, eggs, fireballs, modded projectiles.
Does NOT include arrows, tridents or magic damage.
§71.0§r = Normal (default)
config.battlecorrection.playerMagicAttac:
Multiplier for magic damage dealt by players.
Affects: instant damage potions, thorns, guardian beams.
§71.0§r = Normal (default)
config.battlecorrection.playerSuffersMel:
Multiplier for melee damage received by players.
§70.5§r = Take 50% damage (more resistant)
§71.0§r = Normal (default)
§72.0§r = Take 200% damage (more vulnerable)
config.battlecorrection.playerSuffersArr:
Multiplier for arrow damage received by players.
§70.5§r = Take 50% damage (more resistant)
§71.0§r = Normal (default)
config.battlecorrection.playerSuffersPro:
Multiplier for non-arrow projectile damage received.
§70.5§r = Take 50% damage (more resistant)
§71.0§r = Normal (default)
config.battlecorrection.playerSuffersMag:
Multiplier for magic damage received by players.
§70.5§r = Take 50% damage (more resistant)
§71.0§r = Normal (default)
config.battlecorrection.extraMaxHealth.t:
Adjusts maximum health of non-player entities.
Formula: §eNew Health = Original × (1 + Value)§r
§7-0.5§r = 50% health (weaker mobs)
§70.0§r = Normal (default)
§71.0§r = 200% health (stronger mobs)
§cNote: Does not affect players!§r
config.battlecorrection.extraSaturationH:
Extra flat health restored per tick when regenerating from saturation.
Requires: Saturation > 0 AND Hunger ≥ 18
§70.5§r = +0.5 HP per tick
§70.0§r = Disabled (default)
config.battlecorrection.extraSaturationP:
Extra health restored as percentage of max health per tick.
Requires: Saturation > 0 AND Hunger ≥ 18
§70.05§r = Restore 5% of max health per tick
§70.0§r = Disabled (default)
Extra flat health restored per tick when Hunger ≥ 18.
Works regardless of saturation level.
§70.5§r = +0.5 HP per tick
§70.0§r = Disabled (default)
config.battlecorrection.extraHungerPerce:
Extra health restored as percentage of max health per tick.
Requires: Hunger ≥ 18 (saturation not required)
§70.05§r = Restore 5% of max health per tick
§70.0§r = Disabled (default)
config.battlecorrection.hungerDamageDeca:
Reduces damage dealt based on missing hunger points.
Formula: §ePenalty = (20 - Hunger) × Value§r
§70.05§r = 5% less damage per missing hunger point
§70.0§r = Disabled (default)
At 0 hunger with 0.05: 100% penalty (capped by limit)

Maximum damage reduction from hunger decay.
Prevents complete damage negation.
§70.7§r = Max 70% damage reduction
§70.0§r = No limit (default)
config.battlecorrection.magicDamage.tool:
Flat bonus damage added to all magic attacks.
Affects: instant damage potions, witch attacks, etc.
Damage without an attacker (e.g. poison) is not boosted.
§75§r = +5 damage to all magic attacks
§70§r = No bonus (default)
config.battlecorrection.arrowDamage.tool:
Flat bonus damage added to all arrow attacks.
Affects: bows, crossbows, skeleton arrows, thrown tridents, etc.
§75§r = +5 damage to all arrow attacks
§70§r = No bonus (default)
config.battlecorrection.projectileDamage:
Flat bonus damage for non-arrow projectiles.
Affects: fireballs, bullets from weapon mods, etc.
Does NOT affect arrows, tridents or magic.
Hits that deal no damage (e.g. snowballs) are not boosted.
§75§r = +5 damage
§70§r = No bonus (default)
config.battlecorrection.restoreHeal.tool:
Multiplier for all healing received.
Affects: natural regen, potions, golden apples, etc.
§70.5§r = 50% healing (reduced)
§71.0§r = Normal (default)
§72.0§r = 200% healing (doubled)
config.battlecorrection.bloodthirsty.too:
Restore health based on melee damage dealt.
§cRequires full attack charge to trigger!§r
§70.2§r = Restore 20% of damage as health
§70.0§r = Disabled (default)
Example: Deal 10 damage → Heal 2 HP
config.battlecorrection.almightyBloodthi:
Restore health based on ALL damage dealt.
Works with: melee, arrows, projectiles, magic.
§cMelee still requires full attack charge!§r
§70.2§r = Restore 20% of all damage as health
§70.0§r = Disabled (default)
config.battlecorrection.immuneDamage.too:
Percentage chance to completely dodge an attack.
Range: 0-100%
§725§r = 25% chance to dodge
§70§r = Never dodge (default)
§cDoes not work against unblockable damage!§r
config.battlecorrection.ignoreDamage.too:
Flat damage blocked from all sources.
If damage ≤ reduction: completely blocked
If damage > reduction: reduced by this amount
§75§r = Block/reduce 5 damage
§70§r = No reduction (default)
§cDoes not work against unblockable damage!§r
config.battlecorrection.reducedFallDamag:
Flat fall damage reduction.
MC fall damage ≈ 1 damage per block after 3 blocks.
§710§r = Ignore ~13 blocks of fall damage
§70§r = No reduction (default)
config.battlecorrection.bowSpeed.tooltip:
Multiplier for bow/crossbow drawing speed.
Affects how fast you can fully charge a bow.
§71.0§r = Normal speed (default)
§72.0§r = Draw twice as fast
§70.5§r = Draw at half speed
config.battlecorrection.preparationSpeed:
Multiplier for item use speed.
Affects: eating food, drinking potions, raising shields.
Does NOT affect bows (use Bow Speed instead).
§71.0§r = Normal speed (default)
§72.0§r = Use items twice as fast
config.battlecorrection.jumpLift.tooltip:
Extra jump height in blocks.
Uses vanilla jump boost formula.
§71.0§r ≈ +1 block jump height
§70.0§r = Normal jump (default)
config.battlecorrection.vanillaCriticalH:
Bonus damage for vanilla critical hits (falling attack).
Formula: §eDamage × (1.5 + Value)§r
§70.0§r = 150% damage (vanilla default, 1.5×)
§70.1§r = 160% damage (1.6×)
§70.5§r = 200% damage (2.0×)
§cOnly affects jump-attack crits!§r
config.battlecorrection.customCriticalCh:
Chance to land a custom critical hit.
Range: 0.0 to ∞ (supports overflow)
§70.5§r = 50% crit chance
§71.0§r = 100% crit chance
§71.5§r = 100% crit + 0.5 overflow → extra damage
§70.0§r = Disabled (default)
config.battlecorrection.customCriticalDa:
Damage multiplier when custom crit triggers.
Minimum value: 1.0
§72.0§r = 200% damage on crit (recommended)
§73.0§r = 300% damage on crit
config.battlecorrection.criticalOverflow:
Converts overflow crit chance into bonus crit damage.
Formula: §eBonus = Overflow × Conversion§r
Example with 150% crit chance and 1.0 conversion:
→ 100% crit + (0.5 × 1.0) = +0.5 crit damage
§71.0§r = 100% conversion (default)
config.battlecorrection.enableDetailedLo:
Outputs detailed debug information to the log.
Includes: damage calculations, attribute values,
critical hits, healing amounts, event triggers.
§c⚠ WARNING: Generates MASSIVE log output!§r
§cOnly enable for debugging purposes!§r
config.battlecorrection.curioMarkEnabled:
Admins can use /battlecorrection curio
to let the held item go into curio slots; its attributes apply when worn.
§7false§r = Command disabled, marked items can no longer be equipped
Items already equipped keep working until taken off
§7true§r = Enabled (default)

Click to pick from a list

gui.battlecorrection.editor.attr.locatio:
Click to pick where it applies
Equipment slot: written to vanilla AttributeModifiers, active when held/worn there
Curio slot: written to this mod's curio modifiers, active when worn there; picking one also marks the item as fitting that slot
gui.battlecorrection.editor.attr.desc.ba: Flat magic damage bonus. Addition +5 = your magic damage +5. Only for magic damage with an attacker; poison, wither and other sourceless damage don't count.
Flat arrow damage bonus. Addition +3 = your arrows deal +3 on hit.
Flat damage bonus for non-arrow projectiles (tridents, fireballs...). Projectiles that deal no damage (snowballs, eggs) get nothing.
Dodge chance. Default 1; the value minus 1 is the chance: addition +0.25 = 25% chance to ignore a hit completely. Use addition.
Flat damage reduction. Addition +5 = every hit is reduced by 5 first, all sources.
Flat fall damage reduction. Addition +10 ≈ a 13-block fall deals nothing.
Healing received multiplier. Default 1, addition +0.5 = all healing ×1.5, -0.5 = halved.
Melee lifesteal. Default 1; the value minus 1 is the ratio: addition +0.2 = 20% of fully charged melee damage returned as health.
Almighty lifesteal. Same math as melee lifesteal but applies to melee, arrows, projectiles and magic. Addition +0.1 = 10%.
Bow draw speed multiplier. Default 1, addition +1 = twice as fast, -0.5 = half; at 0 the bow can't be drawn.
Item use speed multiplier: eating, drinking, raising a shield. Default 1, addition +1 = twice as fast; at 0 the item can't be used.
Jump height. Addition +1 ≈ jump 1 block higher.
Bonus for vanilla falling critical hits. Default 1; the value minus 1 is added to vanilla's 1.5×: addition +0.5 = 2.0×, +1 = 2.5×.
Custom critical chance (fraction). Addition +0.3 = 30% chance, rolled for melee and projectiles. Anything above 1 converts to extra critical damage per the config.
Custom critical multiplier. The value plus the base multiplier from the config (default 2.0) is the damage multiplier on a crit: addition +0.5 = 2.5×.
gui.battlecorrection.editor.attr.desc.mi: Max health. Default 20 (10 hearts), addition +4 = 2 more hearts. Cap 1024.
Mob targeting / follow range in blocks. Default 32, meaningless for players.
Knockback resistance, 0 ~ 1. Addition +1 = never knocked back, +0.5 = half. Netherite armor gives +0.1 per piece.
Movement speed. Player default 0.1, the number is tiny so prefer multiply base: +0.2 = 20% faster.
Flying speed for flying mobs (parrots etc.). Creative flight and elytra ignore it.
Attack damage. Bare hands default 1; a sword's damage is a main-hand addition: diamond sword +6.
Attack knockback strength. Default 0, addition +1 ≈ Knockback I.
Attack speed (hits per second). Player default 4; swords are main-hand addition -2.4 (= 1.6/s), axes -3 ~ -3.2.
Armor points. Full diamond is 20, max 30 effective, each point cuts about 4% damage.
Armor toughness. Reduces how much high damage bypasses armor; diamond gives +2 per piece, cap 20.
Luck. Affects fishing and rare loot-table drops, positive is better.
Chance for a zombie to call reinforcements when hurt, zombies only.
gui.battlecorrection.editor.attr.desc.fo: Swim speed multiplier. Default 1, addition +0.5 = 50% faster in water.
Name tag visibility distance in blocks. Default 64.
Gravity. Default 0.08, lower falls slower, negative floats upward.
Auto step height. Default 0.6, addition +0.4 = walk up full blocks without jumping.
Block interaction reach in blocks. Survival default 4.5, creative 5.
Entity attack / interaction reach in blocks. Default 3.

gui.battlecorrection.editor.slots.no_inv: You have no slot types at all. Curios only attaches a curios inventory to players that have at least one slot type; with none there is no inventory and neither commands nor this page can change anything.

Dev fix: open config/battlecorrection-attribute.toml, set devCurioSlots to true, save, then /reload in game (or rejoin the world). You'll get Curios' 10 default slot types, 1 each, and can adjust them here. Keep it off on a real server, where other accessory mods assign the slots.

gui.battlecorrection.editor.enchant.over: Above the vanilla max: may do nothing or behave oddly, test it

enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de: Reduces fire and lava damage and shortens burn time.
enchantment.minecraft.feather_falling.de: Reduces fall damage and ender pearl teleport damage.
enchantment.minecraft.blast_protection.d: Reduces explosion damage and explosion knockback.
enchantment.minecraft.projectile_protect: Reduces damage from arrows, fireballs and other projectiles.
enchantment.minecraft.respiration.desc: Lets you hold your breath longer and drown more slowly.
enchantment.minecraft.aqua_affinity.desc: Mining underwater is no longer slowed down.
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc: Chance to reflect damage to melee attackers, costs extra durability.
enchantment.minecraft.frost_walker.desc: Freezes water under your feet into frosted ice and protects from magma blocks.
enchantment.minecraft.binding_curse.desc: Curse: cannot be taken off until death or the item breaks.
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc: Move faster on soul sand and soul soil, costs durability.
enchantment.minecraft.smite.desc: Extra damage against undead mobs such as zombies and skeletons.
enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods: Extra damage against arthropods such as spiders and silverfish, and slows them.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_aspect.desc: Melee hits set the target on fire.
enchantment.minecraft.looting.desc: More drops and better rare-drop chance when killing mobs.
enchantment.minecraft.sweeping.desc: Increases the damage of sweep attacks against nearby targets.
enchantment.minecraft.silk_touch.desc: Blocks drop themselves when mined, e.g. glass, ores, bookshelves.
enchantment.minecraft.unbreaking.desc: Chance to not use durability, making the item last longer.
enchantment.minecraft.fortune.desc: More drops from ores, crops and similar blocks.
enchantment.minecraft.flame.desc: Arrows set the target on fire.
enchantment.minecraft.infinity.desc: Shooting doesn't consume arrows as long as you have one normal arrow.
enchantment.minecraft.luck_of_the_sea.de: Better chance of treasure and less junk when fishing.
enchantment.minecraft.loyalty.desc: A thrown trident returns to your hand.
enchantment.minecraft.impaling.desc: Trident deals extra damage to aquatic mobs.
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc: Throwing the trident in water or rain launches you with it; incompatible with Loyalty and Channeling.
enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc: A trident hit during a thunderstorm summons lightning.
enchantment.minecraft.multishot.desc: The crossbow fires three arrows for the price of one.
enchantment.minecraft.piercing.desc: Crossbow arrows pass through several targets.
enchantment.minecraft.mending.desc: Experience repairs the item's durability first.
enchantment.minecraft.vanishing_curse.de: Curse: the item vanishes on death instead of dropping.
